items.title: The total complex of a tensor product of K-flat complexes is K-flat

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the total complex of the tensor product of two K-flat complexes is again K-flat (statement lines 3059-3066). The proof is a reduction organised by the associativity isomorphism for total complexes: testing against an acyclic complex M^bullet, the displayed canonical isomorphism Tot(M^bullet tensor Tot(K^bullet tensor L^bullet)) = Tot(Tot(M^bullet tensor K^bullet) tensor L^bullet) (proof lines 3069-3076) moves the test complex next to K^bullet, after which K-flatness of K^bullet makes the inner total complex acyclic and K-flatness of L^bullet makes the outer one acyclic, so the definition gives the conclusion. The content is the choice of the correct associativity isomorphism. The claim is H2: one displayed isomorphism plus two applications of the definition.
